components.subtitle: Run several containers per project (web + worker + database), compose style

singleIntro.title: This project still runs as a single container
singleIntro.body: Define the components below (at least one must be web), then click "Switch to compose". The next deploy will run multiple containers.

empty.title: No components yet
empty.hint: Add your first component (for example your web app) to get started

components.note: Component changes take effect on the next deploy

confirmDelete.message: Delete component {name}? (Removes the definition only, not the data)

form.name: Name (DNS alias)
form.nameHint: a-z, 0-9 and hyphens. Other containers reach this one by this name.
form.sourceLocked: The source cannot be changed after creation. Delete the component and create a new one.
form.imageHint: A tag or digest is required. Do not use latest.
form.noServices: No managed database yet. Create one on the Databases page first.
form.managedEnvHint: Components that set depends_on to this one get connection env injected automatically:
form.isWeb: Web (public), routed through the project's domain
form.healthWaitHint: A deploy waits for the health check for at most about interval × retries seconds. For a service that starts slowly (for example one that loads a model), increase retries.
form.healthCmdHint: Health check command run inside the container (Docker HEALTHCHECK). Required if another component depends on this one with the "healthy" condition (for example {a}, {b})
form.commandHint: Separate arguments with spaces (wrap values containing spaces in "..." or '...'). It does not run through a shell. If you need a shell, write {example}
form.noNewPrivileges: Block privilege escalation in the container ({flag})

repo.backToProject: Go back to the project's repo
repo.needGithub: Connect the GitHub App before choosing another repo
repo.hint: A deploy builds the latest commit of this branch · a redeploy reuses the same commit

promote.title: Switch to multi-container (compose)
promote.ready: Ready. The next deploy will run {n} component | Ready. The next deploy will run {n} components
promote.notReady: At least one component, and at least one that is web, is required before switching

dockerfile.intro: Paste a Dockerfile instead of connecting a repository. Every deploy builds from this content with no git clone. Good for small projects without a repo, or for quick experiments.
dockerfile.label: Dockerfile content

error.noServicesKey: No top-level 'services:' found. This does not look like a docker-compose.yml file.
error.servicesEmpty: 'services:' is empty. There is no service to import.
error.serviceNotFound: No service found. Check the file's indentation.
error.serviceFormat: Unexpected service format. It must be '{'<'}service name{'>'}:' on a line of its own.
error.imageOnly: Service "{name}" uses a prebuilt image (no 'build:'), which cannot be imported. The file needs build.context/dockerfile.
error.noBuildOrImage: Service "{name}" has no 'build:' or 'image:'. Check the file again.

warn.multipleServices: This file has {count} services. Only the first one ("{name}") is used, because a project here supports one container per project.
warn.noPorts: No 'ports:' found in the file. Set the internal port yourself after importing.
